theyear.body1: We opened our doors with two laptops, a shared Google Drive, and noclients. The first few months were rough — we lost our first big  pitch because we quoted a price without fully scoping the work, and  had to eat the difference to finish the project right. whatsapp-widget-case-study.title: How One WhatsApp Chat Widget Got Our Client 13 Leads in 8 Days
whatsapp-widget-case-study.excerpt: A skincare brand in Lagos had 200 weekly visitors and 0 sales. Here's the one change that fixed it.
whatsapp-widget-case-study.ctaLabel: Get WhatsApp Chat Setup for Free

body.text: Client: A skincare brand in Lagos. Problem: 200 people visited their site weekly. 0 sales.
What was wrong?
People had questions: "Do you deliver to Abuja?" "Is this for oily skin?" But there was no way to ask. So they left.
What we did in 10 minutes
We installed a chat widget + connected WhatsApp. Added 1 line: "Hi 👋 Quick question? We reply in 2 mins"
The Result
Lesson: Your website isn't a billboard. It's a sales rep. If no one can talk to you, you're losing money.

why-nigerian-websites-dont-sell.title: Why Most Nigerian Business Websites Don't Sell in 2026
why-nigerian-websites-dont-sell.excerpt: You spent ₦200k on a website. It's beautiful. But crickets. Here's why.
why-nigerian-websites-dont-sell.ctaLabel: Fix My Website — Book Free Audit

body.text: You spent ₦200k on a website. It's beautiful. But crickets. Here's why:
Mistake 1: No Offer
"Welcome to our website" — that's not an offer. Fix: "Book Free 15-min Website Audit" or "Get 10% off this week."
Mistake 2: No Way to Talk to You
Contact form that goes to spam. No WhatsApp. Fix: a live chat widget. 80% of Nigerians will chat before they call.
Mistake 3: No Proof
No testimonials, no portfolio, no team photo. Fix: Add 2 case studies + 3 client logos. Trust = Sales.
Mistake 4: Slow + Not on Mobile
If it loads in 6 seconds, 50% of people leave. Fix: Test your site speed. Use a CDN. Compress images.
The LOC Fix
We check all 4 for free. In 15 minutes we'll tell you exactly what's killing your sales.
